question: The position vectors of the points $A$, $B$ and $C$ are $\hat{i}+2\hat{k}$, $3\hat{i}-\hat{j}+4\hat{k}$ and $2\hat{j}+5\hat{k}$, respectively.(a) Obtain the component forms of $\overrightarrow{AB}$ and $\overrightarrow{AC}$.(b) Find a vector perpendicular to both $\overrightarrow{AB}$ and $\overrightarrow{AC}$ and verify the perpendicularity.(c) Determine the area of triangle $ABC$.
explanation: (a)The coordinates of the points are $A(1,0,2)$, $B(3,-1,4)$ and $C(0,2,5)$. Therefore,`\overrightarrow{AB}=(3-1)\hat{i}+(-1-0)\hat{j}+(4-2)\hat{k}\overrightarrow{AB}=2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k}`Also,`\overrightarrow{AC}=(0-1)\hat{i}+(2-0)\hat{j}+(5-2)\hat{k}\overrightarrow{AC}=-\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+3\hat{k}`(b)A vector perpendicular to both vectors is their cross product.\\overrightarrow{AB}\\times\\overrightarrow{AC}=\\begin{vmatrix}\\hat{i} & \\hat{j} & \\hat{k}\\\\2 & -1 & 2\\\\-1 & 2 & 3\\end{vmatrix}`\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}=-7\hat{i}-8\hat{j}+3\hat{k}`Verification with $\overrightarrow{AB}$ gives`(-7)(2)+(-8)(-1)+(3)(2)=-14+8+6=0`Verification with $\overrightarrow{AC}$ gives`(-7)(-1)+(-8)(2)+(3)(3)=7-16+9=0`Hence, the cross product is perpendicular to both vectors.(c)The area of triangle $ABC$ is`\frac{1}{2}|\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}|=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{(-7)^2+(-8)^2+3^2}=\frac{\sqrt{122}}{2}`Final ResultThe area of triangle $ABC$ is $\frac{\sqrt{122}}{2}$ square units.

options.D:
(a) $\overrightarrow{AB}=2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$, $\overrightarrow{AC}=-\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+3\hat{k}$
(b) $\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}=-7\hat{i}-8\hat{j}+3\hat{k}$, which is perpendicular to both.
(c) Area $=\frac{\sqrt{122}}{2}$.
